contentText: When Xi Jinping hosts Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin at this year's APEC summit, he'll be doing it in one of his country's most technologically advanced cities. Shenzhen is China's premier hub for cutting-edge tech – a place where robo-taxis and AI-powered drones are a normal part of the background... Its current status is the result of decades of policies aimed at opening up the once communist country to international markets and foreign investment.
